failures.assertion: States that MySQL 8.4 does not measure a single-table UPDATE with EXPLAIN ANALYZE and tells the user to run it on their server to see the exact output, instead of promising an exact message
failures.evidence: The output asserts a specific result, "it reports that the statement is not executable by the iterator executor", and never tells the user to run it on their server to confirm the exact output.

failures.assertion: Points to the MySQL manual's EXPLAIN pages for the plan columns (for example https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/explain.html) and says their meanings vary by server version, instead of asserting version-specific column semantics from memory
failures.evidence: It links "https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/explain-output.html" but never says the meanings vary by server version, and it asserts column semantics from memory in a table (e.g. "`type` | `range` / `ref` | `ALL` (full scan of 20M rows)").

failures.assertion: Drops the `order_totals` view before dropping the table and recreates `orders_customer_idx` and the view after the rename
failures.evidence: `DROP VIEW order_totals;` comes before the drop and `CREATE INDEX orders_customer_idx ON orders (customer_id);` comes after the rename, but the view appears only as a comment, `-- CREATE VIEW order_totals AS <saved SQL with total -> total_cents>;`, marked "BLOCKED until filled in", so the script as written never recreates it.
